title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Alex Kim
description:
Summary: Add a set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to the examples repo, and surface the new quickstarts in the docs site. Motivation: We continue to see user requests for end-to-end agent examples that combine Redwood's RAG templates with tool calling (search, calendar, and code-execution). This PR provides curated templates, TypeScript and Python quickstarts, and docs site pages that walk users through configuring tool definitions and wiring the agent to Redwood's hosted and dedicated deployments.

Changes included: - new example templates under redwood-examples/rag/agent-templates (3 templates: assistant-helpdesk, code-assistant, research-agent) - tool-calling quickstarts in redwood-examples/quickstarts/tool-calling (python and ts) - docs site additions: docs/guides/rag-agent-templates.md and docs/quickstarts/tool-calling-quickstart.md - small SDK example fixes (Python) to ensure example snippets use the new async streaming helper API - update to examples README with cross-links and troubleshooting tips

Testing and validation: - Ran docs site build locally (Netlify preview) and validated links - Executed Python and TypeScript quickstarts against local dev server and Redwood hosted staging; validated streaming responses and function call payloads - Unit tests for examples (type checks + basic smoke tests) added and run in CI

Checklist: - [x] Example templates added and documented - [x] Quickstarts for Python and TS added - [x] Docs pages created and linked from guides index - [x] CI checks passing (docs build, SDK tests, lint) - [x] Reviewed and approved by docs and examples reviewers

Notes: Kept the templates intentionally minimal to avoid duplication with larger example apps. Follow-up work (ENG-4321) will add a full end-to-end tutorial with deploy scripts and monitoring guidance.
commits: feat(examples): add rag agent templates (assistant-helpdesk, code-assistant, research-agent)
chore(docs): update examples README and cross-links

Jordan Lee: Minor nits on the TS quickstart (export default vs named export) — fixed in commit 4.
Samira Gomez: Docs build failed on initial run due to a broken link in the TOC; author fixed and re-ran the build; Netlify preview is green now.
Priya Patel: Approved after security section added.

- Added tool-calling quickstarts for Python and TypeScript
